purpose: Reconstruct the original July latent-path wrapper around the temporal-anchor ingress without decoding BTIT outputs into dates and without imposing a +1200-round relation.

preserved_from_original.dataset: ETTh2 low useless load tail360 prev1440
preserved_from_original.selection_rule: top 2 primitives per engine/transform plus protected primitives

output_mapping.method: clip forecast to dataset 5th-95th percentile and divide into 16 equal bins

anchor_ingress_rule.source: raw HTTP response from drand default /rounds/latest
anchor_ingress_rule.on_fetch_failure: record failure; do not synthesize or substitute a round

bundle.relay_assignment: round-robin across the three allowed relays

comparison_after_seal: convert each received raw drand round to its default-chain UTC timestamp
compare received round with the round expected from its receipt timestamp
flag stale/past ingress only after raw receipt is sealed
compare any anomaly with original 6068320 event
claim_boundary: This reconstructs the observable ingress role, not the missing original producer script. A clean current-round result does not explain the 2026-07 anomaly; it tests whether the same wrapper role presently produces anomalous past anchors.
